caption: The drawing shows a single, ornate pitcher positioned in the center of a plain, off-white or beige background with no other objects present. The pitcher is predominantly blue with shades of lighter and darker blue applied to emphasize its curved, vertical grooves and rounded, bulbous body. It has a flared, scalloped mouth at the top, a thick, rounded handle that curves and attaches at the upper lip and side, and a decorative small loop detail at the handle’s lower joint. The base consists of a wide, circular foot that appears slightly darker in shade compared to the rest of the pitcher. There is a signature “N. Amantea” in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Creamer
